description: Lage der Hydranten im Stadtgebiet Braunschweig is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The map shows the location of all hydrants present in the city of Braunschweig. It primarily serves the fire brigade to find the respective water points faster in the event of fires. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Location of the hydrants in the city of Braunschweig" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Gefahrenabwehr, Sicherheit. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
